newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's LPMO to seek 8,143 tonnes frozen beef.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's LPMO to seek 8,143 tonnes frozen beef.

text.p: South Korea's Livestock Products Marketing Organization (LPMO) will invite tenders to buy 8,143 tonnes of frozen beef by 2.00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on December 3, traders said on Friday.
They said acceptable origins were the United States, Canada, Ireland, Sweden, Denmark, Japan, Taiwan, New Zealand, Australia, Finland, Mexico and the Netherlands.
If it passes on the tenders for whole or part of the amount on that day due to high prices, it will re-invite tenders on December 6, they said.
Arrivals were set for Seoul, Pusan, Taegu and Naju.
